behaviourAsImplemented: Carried verbatim from U19 draft f0008f3a5 (see the admission receipt's per-file blob comparison): SQLiteEventHistoryBranchStore.installGenesisBranch and SQLiteEventJournalWriter's first-append call; five journal suites re-pinned backfill 1 -> 0; the new genesis-on-first-append suite.

Four multiplayer-server pins re-aimed (CoordinatedOutcomeCorrection, CoordinatedOutcomeCorrectionSaga, GmCombatRewindCommit, GmCombatRewindPreview): each seed still runs backfillGenesisBranches() after its first append, standing for the mirror's call, and no longer asserts its return count; it asserts that listBranches(STREAM) is exactly one branch 'root' at ancestorDepth 0 with status 'effective' and that readEffectiveHead(STREAM) names 'root' at generation 1 (the table's primary key allows at most one head per stream). Each changed seed function carries a docstring saying so.
Genesis suite test (d) also asserts both streams' genesis rows exist right after the appends, before the backfill runs; this is where mutant M1 is caught now that the four pins are path-agnostic.

MatchStreamJournalMirror.ts docstring of mirrorMatchBatchToJournal corrected (comment only; U19 finding F2): the writer installs the genesis branch and head inside the stream's first append; the backfillGenesisBranches call, which stays, adds nothing for such a stream and still installs any journal stream holding a head but no branch row.

m1AtThePinLevel.reading: with the install skipped, the backfill run by each seed installs the row, so the re-aimed pins pass: they are path-agnostic by the unit sentence ("whichever path installed them"). M1 is caught by the genesis suite, including test (d) before its backfill runs.

nonClaims: No launch-head change: resolveCampaignLaunchHead / campaignLaunchHead.ts are untouched (U20).

The match mirror's global backfill still runs after every mirrored append (MatchStreamJournalMirror.ts:265); it adds nothing for a stream whose first append installed the genesis row (U24 removes the call).
No ladder run, no build, no Playwright: verify:qc:coop-campaign-journey and the authority-recovery group belong to the parent main proof.

Streams that already hold journal heads but no branch row (data from before this change) are not installed by the writer: their next append is not a first append. Only the mirror backfill (combat mode on) covers such match streams.
The re-aimed multiplayer pins do not detect the append failing to install genesis (by design, see m1AtThePinLevel); the genesis suite does.
The genesis suite concurrency test (f) serializes two connections through the IMMEDIATE transaction; it does not drive a true interleaved lock wait.
